}}'''Assimilated Squids''', known internally as '''Infsquid''', are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Squids. The Assimilated Squid does not currently have an [[Assimara Parasites|Assimara form]], nor a [[Feral Parasites|Feral Form]], much like [[Assimilated Big Spider|Assimilated Big Spiders]] and the [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]].
==''Spawning''==
*Spawned when a Squid succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive|Call of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
*Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] to [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 15.

==''Behavior''==
Assimilated Squids are Aquatic Melee Combatants.
*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Squid will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
*If an Assimilated Squid gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a Moving Flesh.
===''Weaknesses''===
*Assimilated Squids, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Assimilated Squids are unable to attack or move outside of water. If they are left out of the water for too long they will start dying of asphyxiation.
